items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) officially active vs Panthers after expected-to-play reports; was Q after limited practices.
items.why: Calf strain limited practice but expected and confirmed active.
items.implication: Maintains WR role alongside Burden in CHI offense.
items.opportunity: Normal route/snap share expected; monitor for pitch count.

items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) situation murky for SNF vs Cowboys; up to him after full practices but Q tag. Giants elevated Berrios and Cambre. Main slate news locked otherwise.
items.why: Post-ACL recovery; player decision on long-term risk.
items.implication: If out, targets to Fields/Mooney/others; projections updating.
items.opportunity: Beneficiary snaps/routes if inactive; monitor pre-SNF.

items.text: Weekend reports summary: Love (ankle) and Odunze (calf) expected to play; Kamara (knee) not expected; Josh Williams activated (Tucker doubtful); Nabers (knee) no news yet.
items.why: Compilation of weekend beat/insider reports for main slate.
items.implication: Projections adjusting; Kamara absence boosts Etienne.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL sprain) is not expected to play vs Lions despite full participation late in week; not quite ready. Confirmed inactive reports follow.
items.why: MCL sprain; progressed but team decided not ready for Week 1.
items.implication: Etienne elevated to lead back role in high-pace NO-DET game.
items.opportunity: Full/near-full snaps and carries for primary backup.

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown will not need surgery on high ankle sprain but sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed no surgery needed.
items.implication: NE WR depth elevated short-term; Maye targets elsewhere.
items.opportunity: Increased role for other NE pass-catchers.

items.text: Roughly all main-slate news in; no major projection changes expected beyond Nabers. Projections live and updating.
items.why: Status reports settled for 1pm games; Nabers SNF variable.
items.implication: Trust current ETR numbers for lineup locks.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers OUT after meniscus trim Tuesday; realistic chance miss only one game and return Week 2 at Chargers.
items.why: Meniscus trim; team optimistic short absence.
items.implication: Mayer primary TE1 this week; Bowers stash ROS.
items.opportunity: Expanded targets/routes for Mayer in slow MIA-LV.

items.text: Cooper Rush starting QB for Falcons; Tua and Penix inactive; Zaccheaus emergency QB and 3rd RB (only Bijan/Brian Robinson active RBs).
items.implication: Bijan heavy workload; limited RB depth.
items.opportunity: Near-every-down Bijan; pass game via Rush.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to play vs Chargers; was Q/game-time.
items.why: Ankle sprain recovery; sources confirm expectation to debut.
items.implication: Likely split with Allgeier; RB2 upside with possible limits.
items.opportunity: Carries and receiving work in debut; handcuff value reverse if limited.

items.text: Week 1 snaps/pace: NO@DET up in pace; MIA@LV slow slog. Updated for Tua/Bowers. CHI-CAR total nudged up.
items.implication: Higher volume for NO skill players; lower for MIA/LV.

items.text: Isaiah Likely ranks high in PPG per target; gimme all the Likely with Nabers not 100% and weak Giants WR2 options (Fields/Mooney).
items.why: 4th in TE FPP target last 3 yrs; high floor with 6+ targets.
items.implication: Strong TE streamer/start vs potential Nabers limits.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard flex play this week but viable; keeping it open on The Chubbler.
items.why: Viable flex option amid CAR RB situation.
items.implication: Startable in deeper/flex spots; monitor committee.

items.text: CMC buy-low after preseason usage concerns and Kaelon Black look; banged up, long flight, weird game—not worried.
items.why: Contrarian on early usage freakout; expects bounce.
items.implication: Hold/start confidently; buy if panicked owners sell.

items.text: When MHJ on field (50%+ snaps), Michael Wilson only 5.5 PPG/13% share; jumps to 28% without him. MHJ expected to play.
items.implication: Fade Wilson if MHJ active; MHJ priority.

items.text: Saquon Barkley averages 136.5 rush yds/6.0 YPC and 21+ PPR in 4 games vs WAS (incl playoffs); WAS front still below average.
items.implication: Elite RB1 start with smash spot.

items.text: Chris Olave 29% target share and 14.7+ PPR in 75% games with Tyler Shough last year; Lions safeties on IR, high O/U.
Parker Washington 24% target share when 70%+ routes; 16.4 PPG at 15%+ share; Ward on BTJ leaves him open vs CLE.
Justin Herbert FPP per attempt 52% higher with Joe Alt on field last year; Alt healthy. Cards DL/secondary weak.
